newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norske Skog sees better paper prices.
newsitem.headline: Norske Skog sees better paper prices.

text.p: Norwegian forestry group Norske Skogindustrier ASA expects a market postive trend for lightweight coated (LWC) magazine paper in the long term, according to a company newsletter.
"The long-term trend for LWC is positive with stronger growth than for most other paper qualities," the newsletter said.
LWC prices fell in the first six months of the year due to high stocks and tougher competition from other products LWC, Skog said.
"The market for LWC is also sensitive to swings in the economy due to advertising activity and advertisment volumes which influence the number of magazine pages."
The company said two new LWC units would come into production during 1996 and 1997 in the Nordic area.
